projection.encoding: canonical JSON, Unicode code-point key order, no insignificant whitespace, one final LF

construction_baselines.rule: Every dynamic vector embeds its exact owner call and ordered mutation programs; this catalogue is a duplicate-free index of those embedded calls. Unlisted baseline names are invalid.

$artifact(fixture).envelope_rule: $envelope_for_owner_record after the exact non-envelope payload is materialized

$authorization_use(operation).rule: Materialize the same operation's $authorization_validation(operation), then construct the exact matching consumed AuthorizationUseRecord fixed by that macro; do not call a store, mint authority, or read current time.

targets: exact operation target refs from accepted I-4 operation_target_contract using the shared manifest/configuration/binding/execution identity

$binding_field(name).rule: Materialize $execution_binding(PRIMARY), then read exactly the named frozen field without copying, coercion, recomputation, or alternate binding.

$correction_record(PRIMARY).rule: original_ref=$envelope_ref(RESULT_A), replacement_ref=$envelope_ref(RESULT_B), exact supplied reason/scope/method/authority refs, prior publication ref preserved, scientific_execution_repeated=false, new manifest ref supplied, and no physical-action field

$digest(Type,label).constructor: the exact named accepted digest wrapper

$enum(qualified_member).rule: Resolve exactly the named accepted/new StrEnum member by module/type/member; aliases, unknown members, and raw-string substitution are invalid.

procedure: materialize every non-envelope field in declared field order
project that exact record payload with accepted ECJ-1 rules
derive object_content_hash once with accepted compute_object_content_hash using the fixed identity fields below

$environment_provenance(PRIMARY).rule: use exact supplied allowlist/exclusion refs and the complete closed section-7 run-metadata order with one aligned evidence ref per class; no ambient read

$execution_binding(PRIMARY).procedure: materialize the exact kwargs below; derive accepted ExecutionSemanticsHash once with compute_execution_semantics_hash over the accepted projection; derive envelope last with $envelope_for_owner_record

$execution_semantics_projection(PRIMARY).rule: use the shared accepted binding, its exact execution_semantics_hash, the exact provenance refs, and disjoint complete closed section-7 execution/run orders

$fixture_bytes(name).rule: bytes.fromhex(fixture_inventory.dummy_bytes[name].hex); require exact byte_count, raw_sha256, SourceFileRawSha256, and ArtifactByteHash agreement before use.

$fixture_field(path).rule: Resolve the exact named scalar field under fixture_inventory.dummy_bytes; unknown paths or type substitution are invalid.

$manifest(state).envelope_rule: $envelope_for_owner_record after the exact non-envelope payload is materialized

$manifest_fields(state).rule: Use exactly the state-selected kwargs from $manifest(state), including the derived envelope, then call artifacts.ExecutionResultManifest once; no second manifest is constructed.

$manifest_ref(state).rule: Materialize $manifest(state) once and construct ObjectRef from that exact envelope object_id, object_version, and object_content_hash.

$publication_record(snapshot).rule: exact manifest/artifact/hash/address/authorization refs plus receipt ref derived from PublicationReceipt for WRITTEN_ONCE when ABSENT or ALREADY_IDENTICAL when SAME; manifest is never a payload field

$ref(label).normalization: ASCII lowercase; every byte outside [a-z0-9._-] becomes one hyphen; trim outer hyphens; empty is invalid

$runtime_provenance(PRIMARY).rule: use exact supplied refs and the complete closed section-7 execution-semantics order; no host or dependency discovery

$source_provenance(PRIMARY).rule: use one aligned source ref/raw hash/artifact hash, accepted commit, dirty source FORBIDDEN, PRESENT completeness, and no filesystem discovery

$trace_validation(state).prefix_rule: empty row_frames, row_count=0, and prefix_digest derived once with accepted compute_canonical_trace_prefix_hash

construction_language.formation_rule: FORMATION mutations replace the direct owner argument with one exact wrong runtime type only after valid support construction; they do not become pre-call constructor failures.
construction_language.recursion_rule: macro expansion graph must be finite and acyclic; derive-after-payload edges are evaluated only after all non-envelope fields
construction_language.required_rule: Resolve the named baseline completely, construct all support values, apply mutations in order, verify all earlier non-active predicates remain true, then call the exact owner once.

collision_audit.object_refs_rule: exact empty tuple for every I-8 validation failure
collision_audit.sharing_rule: Repeated identical occurrence coordinates intentionally share one FailureId; distinct coordinates may not collide.

failure_identity_contract.i8_rule: stage I-8, exact owner interface 1.0.0, empty object_refs, NOT_APPLICABLE EventKey, first active predicate ordinal

required_controls: missing required field for every concrete new record

independent_validation_routes: strict standard-library JSON decoder plus json.dumps canonical encoder
independent recursive JSON string/array/object encoder with Unicode code-point key sorting
Git archive/filesystem plus direct blob SHA-1 predecessor reconstruction
independent vector checklist simulator from baseline/mutation/precedence tables
AST/source-text future graph/export/signature/reachability reconstruction without import

json_profile.canonical: Unicode code-point key order, minimal separators, ensure_ascii=false, one final LF

checks: baseline exists and supplies every required argument
mutation exists and activates its claimed predicate
all earlier unclaimed predicates remain inactive
first active predicate owns expected FailureCode
completed-check count equals first failure ordinal or full checklist length
exact owner is called once for dynamic vectors and zero times for static witnesses
success projection is exact and failure coordinate reconstructs
